title: PEAS
description: Power Electronics Agnostic Structure — Universal container for any electronic component. A valid MAS / CAS / SAS / RAS / controller document is also a valid PEAS.

inputs.description: Per-component design requirements and operating points. Each family schema (MAS, CAS, RAS, SAS, controller) defines the concrete shape of its own inputs; this top-level slot exists so a PEAS document can carry a design seed before it is bound to a real part.

designRequirements.description: Free-form design-requirements payload whose concrete shape is fixed by the sibling family schema referenced in the discriminator branch below.

operatingPoints.description: Operating points the component must satisfy. Shape is fixed by the sibling family schema (e.g. MAS inputs/operatingPoint).

outputs.description: Computed results (losses, thermal, impedance, etc.). May be a single object or an array of per-operating-point results; concrete shape is fixed by the sibling family schema.

oneOf.description: Magnetic component (inductor, transformer, choke) — defined by MAS.
Semiconductor (MOSFET, diode, IGBT, BJT) — defined by SAS.

Control IC (PWM / LLC / PFC / digital / gate-driver / voltage-reference / current-sense / opto-feedback / isolated amplifier / hot-swap). Inline PEAS branch today; candidate for extraction to a CtAS sibling repo once the schema has settled.
